text:
support-bot: New support ticket #48219 from PaperTrail — user reports truncated tool/function-call payload when connection drops during streaming: https://redwood.support/t/48219
alex: saw this, pinging @suresh and @casey — looks like streaming + tool-calls + structured-output interaction
maria: can you paste minimal repro? customer says they see missing `call_args` after reconnect
suresh: quick note — runtime currently doesn't persist partial call frames; we only flush on final event
casey: is this about resumable streaming or framing/ordering? feels like both
alex: both. customer ask: resume after disconnect and have the in-progress tool call restored so downstream webhook still receives valid JSON
suresh: if we add a resumable per-session checkpoint we can restore state, but that adds storage and slightly higher p99 latency
maria: prioritization context — paying Dedicated customer, flagged for churn if not addressed in 2 weeks
alex: agree this is high impact. proposed scope for MVP:
- API: optional `session_id` + `frame_cursor` on stream opens
- Runtime: durable partial-call buffer persisted for short TTL (e.g., 30m)
- SDK: helper to resume and rehydrate call args
casey: acceptance criteria: repro using ticket, automated regression test in e2e harness, doc + SDK example
suresh: rough eng estimate: 3 sprints to get basic durable buffer + resume API; add another sprint for cross-region durability
maria: product ask: ship MVP for Dedicated first, then toggle-in Hosted. target: 6 weeks for MVP to Dedicated customers
alex: decision: create PRD, add backlog item, mark P1 for next planning sprint. rollout plan: canary on Dedicated pool -> Hosted opt-in -> default on after monitoring
casey: will draft PRD today. will include API contract stub and example curl/node snippets, e.g.:
```
# open stream with resume token
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Session-ID: s-123" -d @payload "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream"
```
casey: also adding a minimal wire contract for `frame_cursor` and `partial_call` events
maria: also note: security & compliance review needed for persisted session metadata + KMS for any stored secrets
suresh: +1. include rotation, access controls, and TTL enforcement in PRD
alex: @casey can you create the backlog ticket and link the support ticket? add owner tags and tentative ETA
casey: done — created backlog item 8762 and linked to #48219, assigned to @suresh for implementation, tagging @maria for product review
support-bot: Backlog item 8762 created and linked to ticket #48219
alex: thanks all :thumbsup: we can reconvene after the PRD draft
